description: This Dart source file defines the `AttendanceDatabaseSource` class which provides an abstraction layer for managing attendance data, capable of operating in remote and local modes. It includes methods for user login, marking attendance, and retrieving daily or weekly reports, switching behavior based on environment configuration. The class interacts with external modules like `ApiClient`, `Endpoints`, and `LocalDb`, and handles both online API calls and offline local database operations.

classes.name: AttendanceDatabaseSource
classes.description: Provides methods for user login, attendance marking, and retrieving attendance reports, with support for both remote API and local database fallback based on environment settings.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Attempts login via remote API if enabled; fallback to local database with dummy user data. Stores token upon success.

methods.name: markAttendance
methods.description: Records attendance either via remote API or local database, with optional notes, student name, and period. Returns a confirmation map.

methods.name: getDaily
methods.description: Fetches daily attendance report from API or local database for a specific date.

methods.name: getWeekly
methods.description: Fetches weekly attendance reports between start and end dates from API or local database.
